$comment: Gzipped kb a modern browser loads up front per route (noModule polyfills excluded). Framework baseline (empty Next 16 + React 19.2 page, Turbopack) measured 2026-10-05 at 130.3 kb. Landing rule: <150 kb total; lazy chunks (ogl, gsap, lenis) are asserted in Playwright so that initial + lazy stays <= 150 kb on / and /services. See docs/redesign-plan.md §13.

/blog/*.$comment: Posts ship no animation runtime: framework + tiny islands (TOC, copy buttons). motion's smallest set (~5 kb) or gsap would break this.

/.$comment: Home carries the most islands (hero, facts, terminal, per-stage pipeline). The landing rule is total JS incl. the lazy hero chunk <= 150 kb, asserted in tests/e2e/hero-webgl.spec.ts (143.4 kb on 2026-10-07).
